title: Automatic calibration with BT meter and manual calibration dialog
symptom: When using a Contour Next One BT meter with automatic calibration enabled, sometimes the message 'Use this measurement for calibration?' appears immediately after a measurement, instead of waiting 15 minutes. If 'No' is selected, automatic calibration still works. This issue also occurs during initial calibration prompts when starting a new Libre sensor, where the BT value is not used for initial calibration.
evidence_quote: But sometimes the message "Use this measurement for calibration?" appears immediately after the measurement. If I select "No" the automatic calibration still works fine.
